esim-plan-picker/bd-j0h87kkb.note: Glossy Frutiger Aero loosely suits a telecom plan picker, but nothing helps compare GB and days, the white-text-on-color constraint is contradicted by the white hero and dark-on-light ink pairs, and the sign-sheeting dot screen has nothing to do with the Aero look.

esim-plan-picker/bd-h72qsjp3.note: Bars for comparing GB and days suit an eSIM picker, but putting the bar on section dividers instead of the plan data wastes it, and the Ring Sizer twist never connects to the title, leaving a faint ticked divider with little idea behind it.

esim-plan-picker/bd-39rqqcaf.note: Numbered manual steps loosely suit picking, comparing and buying an eSIM, but one giant number per screen fights the GB and days comparison, the lit board grain clashes with the printed manual mood, and the signature is just a plain header bar with a step label.

flight-checkout-gcc-ota/bd-ou6hyjg3.note: Dhow plank steps with a brass nail suit a multi-step GCC checkout and hang together in teak and brass, but the idea stops at a reskinned stepper and the sea voyage rationale is a stretch for a flight.

flight-checkout-gcc-ota/bd-hrbktbfa.note: Survey paper and contour lines tightening around the total suit a flight checkout and respect the clear total and the Arabic layout, but the idea is mostly a header and hero card skin rather than a fresh mechanic.

flight-checkout-gcc-ota/bd-gwuh8nk1.note: Beirut 1960s modernism is a Levantine tradition rather than a Gulf one, which caps relevance for a GCC brief; the palette, grain and balcony-edge dividers hang together well, but a thin divider line is too quiet an idea to stop a designer scrolling.

coffee-shop-landing/bd-vcnkeh1c.note: A calm Scandinavian header with a teak card suits a coffee landing page, but the twist is garbled and contradicts itself: one type size clashes with a 48 to 120px display headline, the flat blue-underline texture contradicts the teak-grain card and the palette, and the why-it-fits line talks about notes and tasks rather than coffee.

coffee-shop-landing/bd-bc3ab8qb.note: Hairline rules and a boxed text button could suit any page and say nothing about coffee, the texture points to a summary table a coffee landing page does not have, and the Bookmarks twist never shows up in the mechanic, layout or signature.

coffee-shop-landing/bd-7lorzk9m.note: A flat-pack manual is a playful and global frame for a coffee shop, and numbered yellow-box anchors suit section nav, but the fade-with-age band on one card feels tacked on, the tick-off rationale fits tasks rather than a landing page, and the idea skips the manual's line drawings that would make it stop the scroll.

banking-onboarding/bd-e4t6j7q6.note: A calm one-accent rule suits a banking onboarding, but section tabs are an odd fit for a stepped flow, it never addresses the required clear progress, the forest floor mood barely shows, and the rule alone is not an idea.

banking-onboarding/bd-qj9bo2f9.note: Termeh bands sit cleanly on the white base, but the claim that global banking users know this Iranian craft does not hold, the must-keep clear progress is never addressed, and decorative dividers alone are a skin rather than an idea.

banking-onboarding/bd-omq0u3au.note: Onboarding has steps rather than a total, so framing a total misses the page and ignores the clear progress it must keep, the rain-soaked mood never ties to the grid squares, and oversized squares alone are a scale change without a fresh idea.

fitness-empty-state/bd-mf9pdvoe.note: Dala painting has no tie to fitness, and the long scroll rule does not fit a single-action empty state. The toxic green mood clashes with the red and blue flowers, and the pointing hands never appear, leaving a decorative frame rather than an idea.

fitness-empty-state/bd-gr51j7la.note: A fitness empty state can carry a flyer voice, but corduroy softness fights photocopy grit, the bureaucratic mood and flat-pack manual are never used, and the signature is a style wash with no concrete empty state idea such as a flyer announcing your first workout.

fitness-empty-state/bd-46y3xf7w.note: A leaf-skinned button fits an empty state's single call to action, but forest floor has little to do with fitness, and Memphis-style 1985 postmodern accents clash with faded brown leaves and the two-tone limit.

ramadan-food-delivery/bd-rexi5dm9.note: The folder and 80s manual stripe pair well as an office-era look, but nothing ties a manila folder to Ramadan, food or Saudi offers, and the whyItFits about notebooks and tasks belongs to a different page.

ramadan-food-delivery/bd-nv3wopu5.note: The folding paper plane button is a specific, buildable delight, but office notes and a compose card have nothing to do with a Ramadan food offers page in the Gulf, and the soft ruled paper look sits awkwardly with Neo-Brutalism.

ramadan-food-delivery/bd-mlflcvve.note: Nothing in the idea speaks to Ramadan or iftar, and the Scandinavian 1955 twist imports another region's tradition onto a GCC brief. Mica mineral, teak grain and mono tech type pull in different directions. The amber flake button is the only real idea.

saas-pricing/bd-5f2rzk1m.note: A manila plan card with a typed price and a red dated stamp keeps the price clear and suits an analytics product built on timestamps, though the motion ingredient and the thin why-it-fits line are left vague.

saas-pricing/bd-6bszax32.note: Cream plan cards with a marbled strip on the best value plan suit a pricing page and keep the price clear, and the palette and serif type hang together, but the texture placement wavers between the button, header band and an off-page collection cover card, and the idea is a tasteful accent rather than a scroll stopper.

saas-pricing/bd-omdsleqr.note: A flat-pack manual header with a parts count could stand in for what each plan includes and the palette and hairline texture match the object, but a line drawing of intangible analytics software is vague, the tick-off steps rationale fits a page with no steps, and the idea stays in the header strip.

dubai-real-estate/bd-iga15poh.note: Square Kufic tile blocks with a different texture in each are a coherent and striking header idea, but the brick and tile mood suits Persian mosque walls more than Dubai glass towers, and a user-chosen word has no clear job on a listing page.

dubai-real-estate/bd-ej4ir7we.note: Hejazi coral stone and teal rawashin timber suit a GCC property listing, but the graph paper twist only shows up as tick marks and a thin timber divider is too slight to make anyone stop scrolling.

dubai-real-estate/bd-nci0pe0q.note: Farmland pivot circles and Ankara 1930s letterpress do not fit Dubai luxury apartments, the Turkish era is from another region on a GCC brief, the texture sits on step cards a listing page does not have, and the sand bar header is a plain strip rather than an idea.

kids-reading-home/bd-4i9yco1g.note: A rain-dark cyberpunk skin is a stretch for a kids reading home even at wildness 5, the wax seals and fever dream ingredients never appear and clash with the neon era, and the twist is a no-rounded-corners rule rather than an idea about books or reading.

kids-reading-home/bd-044ehsdf.note: A circus poster header suits a playful kids reading home, but circus poster colors and Ankara wax accents compete for the palette and the idea stops at a header strip rather than turning the books themselves into acts.

kids-reading-home/bd-9ug5mj3y.note: Porcelain bands with real light and mid-century colour pair well, but the giant paper clips never show up in the layout or signature, and fragile porcelain is a loose fit for a kids reading home screen.

qatar-gov-services/bd-sls3szfr.note: Ribbed frosted polycarbonate maps neatly onto the column grid and suits a calm, clear-status government dashboard with Arabic support, but limiting it to one lit rib on the empty state keeps it pleasant rather than arresting.

qatar-gov-services/bd-98yb5qmi.note: A segmented status track styled after Gulf salt ponds suits ID renewal and fine stages and keeps status clear, but the cosmic mood does not fit the aerial pond idea, and the teal to pink shift is a mild twist on a standard progress bar.

qatar-gov-services/bd-n1ydqtzg.note: A fines balance in tabular figures fits a Qatar services dashboard with Arabic type and hangs together, but tabular figures is a typesetting rule rather than an idea a designer would stop for.
